purpose: Measure Frankenstein-2.0 German technical-vocabulary and German/English code-switch recognition separately from the ordinary-German FLEURS comparator.
evidence_boundary: This file pins text, scoring and future audio-collection conditions only. It grants zero target-runtime, German-quality, streaming, Trigger4-acceptance or whole-system credit.

external_primary.bounded_observation: Qwen3-ASR officially supports German among its multilingual ASR languages and provides local inference plus a streaming implementation. This does not establish Frankenstein-specific code-switch accuracy.
The report evaluates multilingual ASR and emphasizes real-world evaluation differences; it does not provide evidence for this project's technical lexicon.

normalization: replace underscore and hyphen with spaces
metrics: critical_token_recall using only the predeclared aliases below
anti_goodhart: Do not add aliases after seeing model outputs.
Report aggregate WER/CER and critical-token recall separately.
A low aggregate WER cannot hide a project-critical token miss.
Do not score punctuation/case as a critical-token failure.

future_audio_collection.primary_speaker: human German speaker; natural delivery; do not spell words unless the reference explicitly separates acronym letters

profiles.geometry: approximately 20-40 cm microphone distance; ordinary quiet-room speech
approximately 1-2 m microphone distance in an ordinary room; no artificial denoise before hashing

future_audio_collection.primary_acceptance_audio: human speech only; synthetic TTS may be used only as a separately labelled diagnostic stratum

pipelines: Qwen3-ASR-0.6B behind the deterministic F2 VAD/turn-admission gate

falsifiers: If Qwen3-ASR loses project-critical tokens materially more often than faster-whisper on matched audio, do not promote it merely because ordinary-German FLEURS WER is competitive.
If forced German language handling translates or rewrites embedded English technical tokens, score that separately as a code-switch failure.
If deterministic VAD/turn admission improves false activation but changes project-token recognition, preserve raw and gated scores separately.
A clean near-field pass does not establish far-field room performance.
